style.vernacular: Niger State capital in a hot dusty Guinea-savanna with a harmattan dry season from November to April and rainy season May to October. Ordinary buildings are 1-2 storey cement-block houses and shops in cream, ochre and pale-green painted render under red-brown or green long-span corrugated sheets; older Nupe/Gbagyi/Hausa compounds are mud-render with thatch or zinc roofs and rendered parapets. Government and mosque buildings use white or cream render, green accents and domes, and the streets are lined with tricycles. Soil and verges are red-brown laterite.
